title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented behaviour, licensing and actionable controls are supported. Both API calls are documented as printed, and targeted searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps.

claims.claim: An agent node hands a workflow step to an AI agent that can reason, call tools and read knowledge before returning a result.
